UserObject.plantUmlData:
{
  "data": "@startuml
hide circle
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0

class Patient {
  - patientId: String
  - fullName: String
  - phoneNumber: String
  - dob: Date
  + register(): void
  + updateInfo(): void
}

class Dentist {
  - dentistId: String
  - fullName: String
  - phoneNumber: String
  - specialization: String
  + viewSchedule(): void
}

class Appointment {
  - appointmentId: String
  - appointmentDate: Date
  - timeSlot: String
  - status: String
  + createAppointment(): void
  + cancelAppointment(): void
}

class MedicalRecord {
  - recordId: String
  - diagnosis: String
  - notes: String
  - createDate: Date
  + createRecord(): void
}

class DentalService {
  - serviceId: String
  - serviceName: String
  - unitPrice: Double
  + addService(): void
  + updatePrice(): void
}

class Invoice {
  - invoiceId: String
  - createdDate: Date
  - totalAmount: Double
  - status: String
  + calculateTotal(): Double
}

class InvoiceDetail {
  - detailId: String
  - quantity: Integer
  - lineTotal: Double
  + calculateLineTotal(): Double
}

abstract class PaymentMethod {
  - paymentId: String
  - amount: Double
  - paymentDate: Date
  + processPayment(): Boolean
}

class CashPayment {
  - cashGiven: Double
  - changeAmount: Double
}

class TransferPayment {
  - bankName: String
  - transactionCode: String
}

Patient "1" -- "0..*" Appointment : "đặt"
Dentist "1" -- "0..*" Appointment : "đảm nhận"
Appointment "1" -- "0..1" MedicalRecord : "tạo ra"
MedicalRecord "1" -- "1" Invoice : "phát sinh"

Invoice "1" *-- "1..*" InvoiceDetail : "chứa"
DentalService "1" -- "0..*" InvoiceDetail : "áp dụng cho"

Invoice "1" -- "1" PaymentMethod : "thanh toán qua"
PaymentMethod <|-- CashPayment
PaymentMethod <|-- TransferPayment
@enduml",
  "config": null
}
